description: Attach a published rig or skill to your Rokha (or one of your own listings, published or not). Rokha then lists it on your signed-in turns and reaches for it first. A priced one you have not bought attaches as locked — buying is a separate step; attaching never unlocks it. At most 24 (429 addon_cap). Idempotent. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

listing_id.description: The listing's uuid (from rokha_addons_catalog or market_search), or provider:slug, or a bare Rokha slug.

note.description: Optional: when Rokha should reach for it (≤280 chars).

name: rokha_addon_add
